Against the tables as committed at `origin/main`, written by `tools/verdict_audit.py --base origin/main`. No raw measurement was changed: every native, Omni-Compass and difference in every JSON table is the byte its run wrote. A gauge's declared aim was added where its table's writer had always meant it but not written it (the capacity test: work done, higher). A row can change in more than one way.

| What changed | Standing tables | Every table |
|---|---:|---:|
| A printed change wore the word's sign, opposite to the raw change: now the raw change with its true sign | 997 | 1333 |
| A printed change already had its raw sign: now in separate fields (native → Omni-Compass; raw change; word) | 1310 | 5995 |
| EVEN renamed STEADY, nothing else | 807 | 3553 |
| “STEADY, the same” held to nine decimal places: now STEADY, under the floor (a measured change) | 1 | 20 |
| The word itself: the stored values read by the key that stands, where an older key's words had stayed | 2 | 32 |
| Rows whose printed cells or reading changed | 2473 | 8637 |

Tests: `tests/test_verdict_audit.py` (every stored reading is the key's reading of its stored values; every printed run cell carries the raw change's true sign; the counts of the LOSS ledger and the appraisal are this record's) and `tests/test_readings.py` (the key's rule at the edges: falls, rises, exact equality to nine decimals, a zero native, every three-run combination).
